about: Intended differences from the 1.9.2 baseline, decided by the product owner. compare.js --row <theme> accepts a case only when every differing widget matches an entry for that theme and is identical to the baseline once the entry's strip_pattern (a regular expression) is removed from both; such a case uses the entry's max_pixels. Anything else still fails.

entries.why: On block themes 2.0 adds BuddyPress' priority-nav classes and id to the member profile sub nav. 1.9.2 left them out, so BuddyPress' priority-nav script threw a JavaScript error on every member profile and the sub nav did not collapse into a More menu. The fix changes the sub nav markup and moves it by a few pixels (3 to 7% of the BuddyPress area on Twenty Twenty-Five, 32 cases per candidate).
